synthesis.description: Managers announce openings for analysts, associates, trading assistants and logistics staff, ask the analyst programme for candidates or refer internal candidates, and forward resumes to the hiring group. Interview panels and times are arranged, candidates receive schedules, and interviewers send feedback. Hiring managers request specific analysts be brought into their group, add justification when replacing staff, and decline or keep applicants on file when no opening exists.
steps: Identify an opening and write or revise the job posting.
Request candidates from the analyst programme, HR or internal referrals.
Forward resumes and internal candidates to the hiring manager for review.
Agree the interview panel and schedule interviews with candidates.
Hold interviews and send feedback to the hiring manager.
Request the selected analyst or candidate be placed in the group, with justification where needed.
Reply to unsuccessful or unsolicited applicants.
synthesis.approach: Use a standard opening request form and posting template, a shared interview scheduler that collects interviewer availability once, and a candidate tracker that records resumes, panel, feedback and decision for each opening.
synthesis.rationale: Rounds repeat the same pieces: posting text, candidate lists, panel availability, schedules and feedback. A request and tracking template cuts the back-and-forth over availability and keeps feedback and justification with the opening.
